title: An Artistic Murder
summary: A male escort is found shot dead at his home after attending a gallery event.
method: The killer shot the victim at his house, then took his phone and impersonated him to call the police, establishing an alibi. He also took a book that would implicate him of the crime.
motive: The victim found out that one of the paintings at the gallery was a fake, because the painting had a lighthouse that was only built after the artist passed. A book was the evidence. The victim told the killer this, thinking it was new information. The killer didn't want it to be discovered that he knowingly exhibited fake artwork at his gallery.
notes: Fidel's story in this doesn't make sense. He's grumpy about the victim the entire episode and it should lead to a story about how the victim wronged him but it was Fidel who stopped talking to him after he graduated police college. The story feels underwritten.
